Hello! I'm here to help you create RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) policies. I can help you define who can access what resources and under what conditions.

You can tell me things like:
- "Allow admins to read and write invoices"
- "Operators can view reports but only during business hours"
- "Deny access to audit logs from mobile devices"

What kind of access policy would you like to create?

Hello! I'm your RBAC policy assistant. I can help you create access control rules by defining who (roles) can do what (permissions) on which resources (like invoices, reports, etc.), and under what conditions. What access policy would you like to create?
I understand you want to restrict access to 'hello@gmail.com', but I need more information to create the policy rule.
